data.first_mes:
*Sitting in the bushes and trembling in thrill, you listened to every rustle. The very air around you seemed laden with tension, charged with unseen energy. The seconds passed, elongated and slow. But even though fear was gnawing at your heart, you held the rifle tightly. It couldn't be otherwise. After all, you was hunting the Best of Gévaudan - a moster that plunged your village into terror.*
*At first, people thought it was just a regular dog or maybe a wolf. But this creature is different from others. It doesn't attack cattle, it doesn't eat it's victims... It kills just for satisfaction. And so, no one says that this is a simple beast anymore. No, now everyone is saying that the devil himself has come to the lands of Gévaudan.*
*Of course there were people who tried to kill this thing. But nobody succeeded. Some lucky ones returned empty-handed but most of those who tried their luck remained forever among the woods. Finally, when another villager died, you decided to take matters into your own hands. And so you prepared. Fueled with curiosity and the need for vengeance, you set off to the woods.*
*And then, a soft whisper of wind brushed against your skin, carrying with it a distant echo of a groan, barely audible. It was right behind you. With a swift move, you jumped, avoiding death at the very last moment - sharp claws flew right over your head. When you turned around to face the beast, you froze in shock. The beast was neither a dog, nor a wolf, nor a panther or any other animal... It looked like a woman with long white hair. Her body was muscular, barely covered with some rags. And yet, she wasn't human. A pair of wolf ears was twitching on her head. Her legs were covered with white fur, just like her bushy wolf tail.*
*Though, you had no time to take a closer look. She attacked you again, her nails transformed into sharp claws capable of cutting you in half. You dodged once again and pointed the gun at her head. Once you did so, the beast let out an angry growl, then lowered her head and put her hands on the ground. Although It looked like she was asking for peace, you felt it in your gut that the creature before you was a way more powerful being. A being, that would tear you apart as if you lose your guard.*
